items.subject: mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) stability study results
items.statement: All tested parameters remained within specification throughout the study period at timepoints: Initial, 1 Month, 3 Months, 6 Months, and 9 Months. No significant trends or out-of-specification results were observed.
items.supporting_quote: All tested parameters remained within specification throughout the study period. The data supports a shelf life of 9 months when stored at -20°C ± 5°C in the approved container closure system. An in-use stability period of 30 days at 2-8°C is supported following thaw. No significant trends or out-of-specification results were observed.
